custom_expected:
Step 2: Page titled 'Create Custom Role' opens with 'Basic Details' section at top and 'Permissions' section below.
Step 5: Work orders shows View=ON, Create and Edit=ON, Delete=OFF (Service Advisor row of matrix: View/Edit only).
Step 7: Invoicing and Payments shows View=ON, Create and Edit=ON, Delete=ON.
Step 9: Reports=OFF, Customer portal=ON, Settings=OFF, Billing Portal=OFF.
Step 11: See Financial Data=ON, Manage Accounts Payable and Receivable=OFF, View History Logs=ON. All settings match the Service Advisor row of the Permission Matrix in the spec.
custom_preconds: Choose a template modal open with 'Service Advisor' selected.
custom_steps:
1. Click 'Apply' (bottom-right blue button in modal).
  2. Observe the page that opens.
  3. Scroll to the Permissions section.
  4. Locate the 'Work orders' card.
  5. Check the View, Create and Edit, and Delete checkboxes on the Work orders card.
  6. Scroll to find the 'Invoicing and Payments' card.
  7. Check the View, Create and Edit, and Delete checkboxes on the Invoicing and Payments card.
  8. Scroll to the Page Access card.
  9. Check the Reports, Customer portal, Settings, and Billing Portal toggles.
  10. Scroll to the Cross-Cutting Toggles card.
  11. Check See Financial Data, Manage Accounts Payable and Receivable, View History Logs.
title: Apply button confirms template and opens Create Custom Role page with settings pre-filled
